name: nihongo-tooling
description: Local-only build/process scripts for the nihongo app. Not a published package — exists so node_modules has a home and scripts can require their dependencies cleanly.

scripts.verify: node scripts/validate-data.mjs && node tests/capture.mjs tests/golden-after.json && node tests/compare.mjs tests/golden-baseline.json tests/golden-after.json
scripts.test:reader:e2e: node reader-extension/tests/extension.e2e.mjs && node reader-extension/tests/panel.e2e.mjs && node reader-extension/tests/bar.e2e.mjs && node reader-extension/tests/popup.e2e.mjs && node reader-extension/tests/async-ui.e2e.mjs
